Whole bone marrow plasma enables researchers to investigate specific components of bone marrow at the molecular level.

Novaseek Research specializes in data-driven biospecimen sourcing. Targeted consenting of selected patients is also available to meet customer orders. Using our proprietary CDNR platform, Novaseek mines real-time clinical data in the EMR to select immediately available remnant biospecimens from patients that match even the most complex requirements. Serial specimens, such as pre and post treatment cases, may also be requested. Customers can view, search, and download available clinical data (including longitudinal data) for each case including:
 Current ICD10 diagnosis, medical history, and problem list
 Medication lists
 Chemo, radiation, and other treatment data
 Results of laboratory testing
 Narratives such as pathology, consult, and radiology reports
Specimen types include blood, plasma, serum, urine, stool, peritoneal, and other fluids as well as slides, smears, and paraffin blocks/FFPE specimens. Plasma and serum are available in amounts of 1-2mls. Turnaround times vary by request, but some orders may be served in under 48 hours.
